malformed_second_origin_policy.behavior: Reject a second distinct reward origin without changing, replacing, delaying, resetting, reopening, settling twice, or charging again for the first origin; the accepted first reward continues under the frozen lifecycle.

owner_reported_platform.provenance: Owner summary in the A5 task; no raw diagnostic files or hashes were supplied and A6 did not rerun diagnostics.
owner_reported_platform.windows_host: Windows 10 Pro build 19045, elevated administrator token, Hyper-V operational
owner_reported_platform.ubuntu_guest: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS; systemd 259; unified cgroup v2

architecture.selection: Retain Hyper-V host plus root-managed Ubuntu systemd/cgroup v2 service; no alternative architecture search.
architecture.workload_leaf: Supervisor, exactly three approved corrective test commands, and all descendants including the 23 sequential validator CLI descendants.
architecture.monitor: Separate root-managed guest service, outside corrective workload leaf but inside the dedicated accounting slice; proposed 5% CPU quota; same guest kernel and scheduler.
architecture.artifact_daemon: Root-managed FUSE service inside the guest accounting slice; proposed 5% CPU quota.
architecture.host_controller: Separate elevated host controller/watchdog bound to exact VM GUID and name; host CPU separately accounted.
architecture.guest_host_channel: Required for authenticated heartbeat, cutoff/control, and evidence transfer; no non-network transport or authentication contract is selected or verified. Owner-reported guest network and Guest Service Interface are disabled.
architecture.bootstrap_policy: Provision and query all controls before one-shot dispatch; no workload process may run before its cgroup is effective.

memory_proposal.original_metric: 512 MiB aggregate Windows peak working set
memory_proposal.descendants_included_by: Hierarchical cgroup membership; fork/exec descendants remain in subtree unless privileged migration occurs.
memory_proposal.failure: Any corrective memory.max/oom/oom_kill event increment, OOM exit, nonzero workload swap charge, or unreadable counter fails the corrective invocation. Q03 alone expects oom/oom_kill increments from one 16 MiB-step touched allocator inside the 512 MiB case leaf; outer/guest OOM fails qualification.
memory_proposal.swap_note: MemorySwapMax=0 does not establish no guest-wide swap or prevent Hyper-V host overcommit; verify guest swap and zswap separately.

cpu_proposal.measurement: cpu.stat usage_usec is aggregate user plus kernel; user_usec and system_usec are components.
cpu_proposal.scope: Baseline usage_usec is captured after guest monitor/FUSE readiness immediately before workload activation at T0. Measure the subsequent dedicated guest-slice delta for supervisor, all test descendants, monitor and FUSE. A trusted out-of-slice evidence collector reads final cpu.stat only after the slice is populated=0; its CPU, host controller, VM boot and unrelated guest services are excluded and separately logged. Owner approval required.
cpu_proposal.affinity: One verified cpuset.cpus.effective CPU; parent cpu.max=100000 100000; child shares workload=90000 100000, monitor=5000 100000, FUSE=5000 100000. cpu.max is a rate limit, not lifetime CPU enforcement.
cpu_proposal.stage_one: Write cgroup.kill=1 and confirm cgroup.events populated=0.
cpu_proposal.stage_two: Host Stop-VM -TurnOff on nonempty leaf, lost heartbeat, or unavailable guest confirmation; request immediately and require two host State=Off observations within nine seconds.
cpu_proposal.margin_derivation: One effective CPU multiplied by the 0.1-second polling target plus the proposed 1-second cgroup-kill stage plus 9-second host-off stage.
cpu_proposal.status: BLOCKED — no finite worst-case monitor, scheduler, cgroup-kill, channel, VMMS, or VM-Off response bound is established.

wall_proposal.t0: Immediately before activating the already-booted, preconfigured workload service.
wall_proposal.host_state_confirmation: VM State=Off observed twice, bound to VM GUID; no later than T0+180s
wall_proposal.failure: Failed host command, missing state, or VM not confirmed Off by T0+180 is a hard boundary breach; reject evidence, consume marker, no retry.
wall_proposal.status: BLOCKED — QPC is monotonic but no bounded scheduling or Hyper-V command/VM-Off latency is established.

artifact_proposal.metric: Per-invocation sum of per-file logical st_size high-water marks; sparse holes count; credit is not returned on truncate or unlink.
artifact_proposal.backing_volume: 33554432-byte fixed-size host-ACL-protected VHDX; ext4 4 KiB blocks, 512 total inodes, preallocated 4194304-byte journal, pinned image hash and UUID; fit remains unverified.
artifact_proposal.mediator: Proposed root-managed FUSE namespace with bounded per-inode write-ahead ledger; absent and unqualified; only this namespace would be writable in the workload mount namespace.
artifact_proposal.frozen_mkdtemp_writefile_compatibility: Required but unverified; FUSE implementation absent and not tested.
artifact_proposal.over_limit_write_error: ENOSPC before an over-cap request changes file length or ledger; accepted write prefixes may persist and are charged. Corrective invocation fails with no retry/resume on unexpected ENOSPC.
artifact_proposal.backing_or_ledger_failure: EIO, fail closed and make artifact mount read-only; invocation fails. Refund reserved credit only when the backing operation was not issued; otherwise retain candidate high-water reservation. Reject one-shot restart if ledger is torn or unreconciled.
artifact_proposal.descriptor_admission: No socket activation/FD store/passed descriptors; trusted wrapper opens stdio in private mount namespace, closes all descriptors above 2 before a single exec, and monitor permits only later writable descriptors targeting the FUSE mount.
artifact_proposal.failure_reserve: One preallocated 65536-byte root-owned file inside total byte/inode caps, not exposed or descriptor-passed to workload; trusted guest monitor uses a separate append-only descriptor/counter to append at most one failure record even if artifact FUSE is read-only.
artifact_proposal.durable_ledger_crash_consistency: Fixed per-inode write-ahead high-water records and no-restart-on-pending-record semantics are proposed but unimplemented and unqualified; admission fails on unreconciled state.

a6_qualification_budget.status: PROPOSED ONLY; NOT AUTHORIZED OR EXECUTABLE

owner_decisions_required: Approve or reject the Linux 512 MiB cgroup-accounted memory metric, zero-swap rule and OOM policy.

Approve or reject the 120-second work plus 10.1-second termination reserve and 130.1-second absolute CPU ceiling, including guest monitor/FUSE inclusion and host controller/evidence-collector exclusions.
Approve or reject the wall-clock scope, the 170/171/180-second stages, and required confirmed VM-Off by T0+180.
Approve or reject the logical-file high-water artifact metric, 512 inode limit, 32 MiB fixed VHDX and FUSE mediation.
Approve or reject the separate 12-case A6 qualification budget and its resource ceilings for independent prereview only.
Authorize or reject infrastructure changes for cpuset activation, FUSE, fixed artifact VHDX and host watchdog/control channel.
blockers: The proposed 100 ms polling target and 10.1-second CPU termination envelope are not verified hard bounds; therefore 130.1 CPU seconds is not an established absolute ceiling.
No bounded host scheduling, VMMS, Stop-VM command, or confirmed VM-Off latency is established by owner diagnostics or documentation.
No authenticated non-network guest-host heartbeat/control/evidence transport is selected or verified; owner-reported guest networking and Guest Service Interface are unavailable.

A5-compatible FUSE logical-high-water artifact mediation and crash-consistent ledger do not exist in the repository and have not been implemented or qualified; the 32 MiB backing-volume fit is unverified.
Owner has not approved the memory, CPU, wall, artifact or separate qualification-budget amendments.
Owner-supplied host/guest details remain unverified raw evidence.
